options.name: --prg
options.description:
.prg file to run. It is put on the SD card and run by
an AUTOBOOT.X16.

options.name: --rom
options.description:
rom file to load, will look for rom.bin locally, then
using the BITMAGIC_ROM environment variable, then in
the user's BitMagic folder.

options.name: --fetch-rom
options.description:
Download the latest ROM into the user's BitMagic
folder, then exit.

options.name: --code
options.description: Code file to compile. Result will be loaded at 0x801.

options.name: --write
options.description: Write the result of the compilation.

options.name: --warp
options.description: Run as fast as possible.

options.name: --sdcard
options.description:
SD Card to attach. Can be a .zip or .gz file, in the
form 'name.xxx.zip', where xxx is either BIN or VHD.

options.name: --sdcard-size
options.description:
SD Card size in mb if the card is being created by the
emulator.

options.name: --sdcard-folder
options.description: Set the home folder for the SD Card.

options.name: --sdcard-synctox16
options.description:
Sync any changes to the home directory to SD Card.
Root directory only.

options.name: --sdcard-syncfromx16
options.description: Sync any changes to SD Card to the home directory.

options.name: --sdcard-sync
options.description:
Sync any changes to SD Card to the home directory, or
vice versa. Root directory only. Same as setting
--sdcard-synctox16 --sdcard-syncfromx16.

options.name: --sdcard-file
options.description:
File to add to the SD Card root directory. Can add
multiple files and use wildcards.

options.name: --sdcard-write
options.description:
SD Card file to write at the end of emulation. Can be
a .zip or .gz file, in the form 'name.xxx.zip', where
xxx is either BIN or VHD.

options.name: --sdcard-overwrite
options.description: When writing the SD Card file, it can overwrite.

options.name: --sdcard-update
options.description:
Sets 'sdcard-write' to the 'sdcard' parameter and
enables overwrite.

options.name: --cart
options.description:
Cartridge file to load as a standard binary file. Can
be a .zip or .gz file, in the form 'name.cart.zip'.

options.name: --dump
options.description: Start emulator with the state from a dump file.

options.name: --dump-folder
options.description: Folder to write dump files (Menu + Left Ctrl + S) to.

options.name: --wifi
options.description: Enable the wifi card at $9fe0.

options.name: --scale
options.description: Window scale, e.g. 2 for double size.

options.name: --mute
options.description: Don't play audio. Emulation is unaffected.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
